landing.pill: Fast answers and agents, on your own infrastructure
landing.headline2: Get answers, or get it done.
landing.sub: One platform with two modes. Fast answers with sources you can check. Agent mode plans, uses your tools and asks before it acts. An automatic router chooses for each question.
landing.flowAria: A question goes to the router, then either the fast lane (hybrid search, rerank, generate) or the agent lane (plan, MCP tools, approval), and both end in an answer with citations
landing.flowAgent: AGENT · plans, calls tools, asks first

guarantees.label: every fact links to its source
data stays on your infrastructure by default
API keys ever shown in the UI

landing.featuresLead: Every step is configured in the admin console, with no code changes.

router.title: Two modes, one smart router
router.body: Simple lookups go to fast answers. Tasks that need tools go to the agent. You set the confidence threshold and the fallback.

flow.title: Visual pipeline builder
flow.body: Ingestion, retrieval, reranking, generation and guardrails, each step configured per chatbot.

bots.title: Many chatbots, scoped access
bots.body: HR, IT, Legal and more. Each bot has its own knowledge, pipeline and groups, so people only see their bots.

providers.title: Modular providers and BYOK
providers.body: Swap LLM, embeddings, reranker, vector store or parser. Local or external. Keys live in OpenBao, write-only.

tools.title: Tools through MCP
tools.body: Connect tickets, calendars, HR systems and databases as MCP servers, with per-tool permissions.

automations.title: Automations and approvals
automations.body: Scheduled and event-driven agents that draft, check and act, and wait for a person when it matters.

health.title: Knowledge health
health.body: Spots stale, conflicting and missing documents, and the questions your knowledge can't answer yet.

channels.title: Wherever people work
channels.body: Web app, mobile, Microsoft Teams, Slack and a REST API, all with the same permissions and sources.

eval.title: Evaluate before you ship
eval.body: Ragas scores on every pipeline version, traces in Langfuse, and a one-click rollback when quality drops.
eval.gateNote: A version that scores below the gate cannot be published.

providers.keyHint: Keys are write-only: they go straight to the secret store and are never shown again.

providers.previousKeyUntil: The replaced key is still tried until {until} if the new one is rejected.
providers.usageHint: Counted from answers and Playground runs, attributed to the provider that served each call. Cost uses the prices above.

myFiles.title: My files
myFiles.hint: Only you can see these. Your chats search them once they are indexed.
myFiles.loadFailed: Your files could not be loaded.

modes.title: How answers are made
modes.body: Fast mode searches the documents you are allowed to open and answers from them in a few seconds. Auto and Agent modes, which can work through several steps and prepare actions for your approval, are not available yet.

checking.title: Checking answers
checking.body: Every fact in an answer has a number. Click it to see the passage the answer used, and open the document. If the documents do not answer your question, the assistant says so instead of guessing, and you can pass the question to a person. If an answer looks wrong, rate it.

files.title: Your own files
files.body: Upload PDFs, Word files and other documents under Chats & knowledge, or with the paper clip in a chat. Only you can see them, and your chats search them once they are indexed. You can remove them at any time.

access.title: Why can't I see an assistant?
access.body: Each assistant is shared with specific teams. Ask your manager or the platform team for access.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Answers are generated from company documents you have access to and can be wrong. Your chats are stored so you can come back to them; you can delete a chat from its menu. AI models run on your company's own servers unless an assistant is allowed to use an external provider: such answers carry an "External model" label.

stuck.title: Still stuck?
stuck.body: Check whether the service is running normally, or contact your platform team.

pipeline.title: Pipelines
pipeline.subtitle: How each assistant finds and writes its answers. You edit a draft; publishing makes it live.
pipeline.runtimeLater: These settings are saved with the draft; they take effect when the agent and router arrive in Phase {phase}.

embedding_instance_id.label: Embedding instance
embedding_instance_id.hint: Changing it re-indexes every attached source.

semantic_similarity_threshold.label: Semantic split threshold
semantic_similarity_threshold.hint: Semantic chunking only: a new chunk starts where sentence similarity drops below this.

parent_chunk.label: Parent chunk
parent_chunk.hint: Give the model the whole section around a matching chunk.

describe_images.label: Describe images
describe_images.hint: Runs a vision model inside the parser; slow without a GPU.

dense_weight.label: Dense weight
dense_weight.hint: Hybrid only; the keyword side gets 1 − this.

sparse_min_term_match.label: Minimum matching terms
sparse_min_term_match.hint: Candidates must contain at least this many words of the question.

german_compound_splitting.label: German compound splitting
german_compound_splitting.hint: Keyword search also finds the parts of compounds and the compounds that end in a word, using the words in this chatbot's documents.

query_rewrite.label: Rewrite follow-up questions
query_rewrite.hint: Turns "and for e-books?" into a full question before searching.

metadata_filter.label: Metadata filter
metadata_filter.hint: For example: language in [de, en] AND source_id = <id>. Permission filters are always added and cannot be removed.

min_score.label: Minimum relevance
min_score.hint: Below this, a source is dropped; no sources means no answer.

system_prompt.label: System prompt
system_prompt.hint: Variables: {company}, {user_name}, {user_team}, {today}. Citation and no-answer rules are always added.

agent_when_live_data.label: Use Agent when live data is needed

agent_when_action.label: Use Agent when an action is asked for

input_guardrail_instance_id.label: Input safety check
input_guardrail_instance_id.hint: Checks the question (Llama Guard) before anything else runs.

output_guardrail_instance_id.label: Output safety check
output_guardrail_instance_id.hint: Checks the answer before it is shown.

pii.label: Personal data before external models
pii.hint: Mask: replaced with placeholders before an external model sees them, and put back in the answer. Block: the question is refused.

no_promises.label: No promises
no_promises.hint: Block answers that promise refunds, deadlines or exceptions.

pii_instance_id.label: PII provider
pii_instance_id.hint: Finds names, addresses and IDs (e.g. Azure AI Language). E-mail, IBAN, phone and card numbers are always found by local rules.

tools.title: Tools (MCP)
tools.subtitle: MCP servers give agents tools. Each call is checked against the tool's policy and the user's permissions.
tools.builtinText: search_documents · read. Searches the chatbot's sources with its retrieval pipeline; the user's own document access applies on every call.
tools.registerSubtitle: Connect, then review each tool before agents can use it.
tools.name: Name
tools.keyNote: Written to OpenBao. Nobody can read it back; only the last 4 characters are shown.
tools.reviewNote: After connecting, review each tool: mark it read, write or destructive, choose approvers and who may use it. Descriptions are shown before agents see them, to catch hidden instructions.
tools.calls7d: {count, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}} in 7 days
tools.reviewHint: Agents see each tool's description. Read it before enabling: a description can contain hidden instructions.
tools.signedOffNow: Signed off. Tools can now be enabled.
tools.needsReviewer: A security reviewer must sign this server off before its tools can be enabled.
tools.callersHint: None selected: everyone who may use the chatbot.
